title: Nick Bosa, Christian McCaffrey don't practice as 49ers begin Week 1 preparation

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Nick Bosa, Christian McCaffrey don't practice as 49ers begin Week 1 preparation
sources.description: Nick Bosa and Christian McCaffrey didn't take part in team drills during the San Francisco 49ers' first full practice Monday in Melbourne, Australia.
